Hi Emily / team —

Great to meet today — thanks for the productive discovery. As promised, below is a concise recap of the proposed POC scope, success criteria, timeline, and an initial RACI to help us move to kickoff. Please confirm owners and any changes to the timeline so we can lock in resources on our side.

POC goal (high level): verify Redwood Inference can meet Verdant Health's latency, throughput, and data handling requirements for clinical-search and chart-summarization workflows in a trial environment.

Success criteria (proposed):
- Latency: 95p token latency <= 450ms for the interactive flow (95% of requests)
- Throughput: sustain 120 concurrent sessions during simulated busiest hour with <5% error rate
- Output quality: pass 4/5 agreed prompt test cases (we'll share test prompts)
- Data handling: logs and payloads retained per Verdant policy; no PHI leaving your VPC for private deployment scenario

Proposed timeline (6-week trial):
- Week 0: Kickoff, access & non-prod infra provisioned
- Week 1: Model + integration baseline setup; smoke tests
- Week 2-4: Evaluation window (run workload, collect traces/metrics, quality checks)
- Week 5: Iterate on perf/tuning based on results
- Week 6: Wrap-up, executive review and recommendation

Initial RACI (please confirm owners):
- Infrastructure (network, VPC, accounts): Verdant owner — [please name]
- App integration (SDKs, endpoints, request shaping): Verdant dev lead — [please name]
- Security & compliance (questionnaire, KMS, access controls): Verdant security — [please name]
- Procurement / contracting (PO, order form, budget): Verdant procurement — [please name]
- Redwood owners: Marissa (engagement lead), Lauren (technical onboarding), Aditya (SE - perf), Monica (CSM)

Attachments: verdant-POC-success-criteria.pdf (detailed acceptance tests + sample prompts)

Next steps / asks for Verdant:
1) Confirm who will own Infrastructure, Security, App, and Procurement (name + email)
2) Confirm target kickoff week (we have capacity week of Apr 20 or Apr 27)
3) Provide any network constraints (IP ranges, proxy, egress rules) and whether you prefer Private deployment (VPC) or a hosted trial

I'll follow up with a calendar invite once owners and dates are confirmed.

Thanks —
